reviewedRevision: 8b601fe plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-level shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round, one clean-worktree test run and a short browser check.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own reaction-limited paddle bot cleared all 20 fields on 3 seeds at both 0.25 s and 0.35 s reaction at 60 Hz, the slowest clear taking 170 s. Idle, mash and random-key policies won 0 of 72 runs each on fields 3-20. Scripted input matched across 30, 60 and 120 Hz on four fields; four 120 s runs showed no tunnelling or escape; 30 fuzz runs with hostile dt and pointer values threw nothing; a loss ended exactly once and stayed frozen; junk and throwing progress stores were safe.

findings.observation: Only 3 hard-coded fields and no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven fields (teaching 1-7, combination 8-14, mastery 15-20) built from plain, armoured, reactor and drifting bricks, each with an accurate EN/ZH tip, plus a field select and env.progress continue.

Fair start and physics: the ball stays docked until launch, field 1 has a two-save training net, rough walls and ceiling break endless vertical or horizontal loops, paddle hits cap ball speed, reactors chain, and fixed 1/240 s steps make every frame rate play the same.

Added tests/starbreaker-quality.test.js: per-field clears, blind-policy bars, a reaction-limited bot at 30, 60 and 120 Hz, determinism, hostile input, broken progress stores, EN/ZH end messages and a frozen terminal state.

openNotes: Launching while the paddle slides at full speed sends the ball off at about 449 px/s for its first rise, above the 360 cap that applies after the first paddle contact.
A pointer that tracks the ball wins every field, as in classic breakout; this is treated as skill.
Some fields take a bot over two minutes; human clear times are unmeasured.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: Chinese: Start opened field 1 of 20 with the ball docked and the field tip shown; Space launched it.

Chinese loss: with the paddle idle the training net saved the first ball, which was lost at 16.8 s; after relaunches the balls ran out and the loss screen showed score 535 and 小球用完了，再次挑战星空吧。 Play again restarted field 1 with 3 balls.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): the Launch touch button launched the ball and the Left button moved the paddle; bricks broke and the score reached 150.
Not covered in the browser: a field win and the field select, which appears only after a first clear; the reviewer's bots and the quality tests cover both.
